text: {"assertions":["Migration 0042_add_index.sql in storage/sql/migrations experienced a lock timeout issue.","The lock timeout appeared as a statement timeout during a rolling restart of the fleet.","The root cause was a cache entry that was never invalidated on write operations.","The fix involved invalidating the cache entry inside the write transaction.","The fix was submitted in PR #3799 on branch fix/lock-timeout-1.","The lock timeout can be reproduced by running the migration against a heavily loaded table.","The fix was validated with nightly rollups matching source counts for 22 consecutive days."]}
